violations.text: The hand-washing sinks throughout are lacking hand-washing signage. PIC created signs during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025
The hand-washing sink in the coffee prep area was lacking paper towels. PIC replaced paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Inspector observed a sponge in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed sponge. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration units. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
The floors in the restroom and office areas are in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the back storage area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2025
Handwashing sinks are lacking handwashing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025
(Various beverages ) were observed stored on the floor in the (throughout establishment ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back storage) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2025
